name: Asagiri Tatsuya
source: Main character of the story. Student in the Catherina Academy, after the disappearance of his father and soon after the death of his mother his house consists of his cousin Sayaka and little sister Mai. Works in the Italian food place next to his house Samon, where the Takamizawa family lives. Has a habit of raising dogs (currently three). Has an interest in Moon studies.
